title: Dabo Swinney on NFL players going back to college: It's embarrassing, we have no rules

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dabo Swinney on NFL players going back to college: It's embarrassing, we have no rules
sources.description: Clemson coach Dabo Swinney is preparing to open the season on Saturday against LSU, which has been at the forefront of attempting to get players who were on NFL rosters back into college football.
